text.id: Hari 3 belum ditulis. Ceritanya berlanjut di versi berikutnya.
text.en: Day 3 isn't written yet. The story continues in the next build.

summary.id: Sekar pergi ke dermaga Senin malem, dan orang-orang terdekatnya menyimpan sisanya. Raka baru mulai menyusun potongannya.
summary.en: Sekar went to the pier on Monday night, and the people closest to her are keeping the rest. Raka has only begun to put the pieces together.
